Bubble tails face Jango or the woman. Their faces, eyes, mittens and tangerines remain visible. Quilt occlusion is intentional; no character stretching or new artwork was introduced.
0–2 hook; 2–6 invitation; 6–10 silent written movement cue; woman 10–12 and Jango 12–16; brand and one question remain 16–20. No blended text at cuts.
Start/mid/end and half-second samples show consistent full-frame fill and no exposed edges. The small zoom keeps the core expressions and food visible.
Dialogue, eyes, mouths, tangerine action and final question remain clear. Simulated right-side controls touch the peripheral quilt/hat edge in close shots. This is not live Instagram acceptance.
Title moved down before final export so all glyphs survive both 3:4 and square center crops. The solo blanket Jango and title are recognizable at 360px.
